notes: No precedent (first Singapore worker on this SN). Direct fetch worked throughout (custom Rails/Nuxt-style storefront, no WAF block encountered); robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow, only generic scraper bots blocked. Site uses Spree-like flat URL taxonomy (/decor/*, /lighting/*, /kitchen/*, /soft-furnishings/*) plus root-level nav collections (/drinkware, /decorative-mirrors, /decor-essentials). qty source: every listing page renders an exact breadcrumb count '(N items)' AND an independent pagination JSON meta object (current_page/per_page/total) embedded in the page; both were cross-checked and agreed on every category tested (e.g. floor-lamps: breadcrumb=54, JSON total=54; wall-mirrors: breadcrumb=15, exact count of unique /products/ hrefs on page=15) -- treated as reliable, matching Rule 1's exhaustion-check spirit (server-computed total, not a Shopify-style inflated metafield; this site is not Shopify -- /collections.json 404s). Rule 0.6 duplicate/overlap handling (verified via product-ID set comparison, not just names): DROPPED as exact-duplicate-URL or pure facet re-cut: /decor/wall-photo-frames/wall-frames (redirects to parent wall-photo-frames, same page), /decorative-mirrors (byte-identical to /decor/bathroom-mirrors, same title+count+products), /decor/round-mirrors (4 items, 100% subset of wall-mirrors' 15 -- shape facet), /decor/new-mirrors (site's own 'Mirrors' parent-category page, not a leaf), /decor/all-clocks (site's own 'Clocks' parent-category page over Table/Wall/Alarm Clocks, not an independent leaf), /decor/home-wall-decor (site's own 'Home & Wall Decor' parent-category page over Photo Frames/Wall Art & Decals/Canvas & Art Prints/Decorative Accents, not a leaf), /decor/garden-decor (site's own 'Garden Decor' parent-category page over Vases-Pots-Planters/Plants&Flowers), /kitchen/tableware (site's own 'Tableware' parent-category page over Plates&Bowls/Mugs&Glasses/Jugs/Condiment Sets/Placemats&Coasters), /decor/wall-photo-frames/photo-frames (nested child re-using the identical 'Photo Frames' label as its own parent -- used the parent count instead), /soft-furnishings/curtains-curtain-rods/curtain-rods (identical 8-item set to its own parent 'Curtains & Rods'; used parent), /decor/curtains-curtain-rods-2 (redirects to /soft-furnishings/curtains-curtain-rods, same page). KEPT despite overlap per Rule 0.6 'type tree AND room/nav tree, emit both': Kitchen>Tableware>Mugs & Glasses (49) vs root-nav Drinkware (63) -- partially overlapping product sets (shared mugs/tumblers) but Drinkware is a distinct top-level nav collection also containing pitchers not in Mugs&Glasses; both kept, overlap flagged here rather than double-padded silently. EXCLUDED as out-of-scope content after inspecting actual product titles (mixed roll-ups, 'drop don't pad'): /decor/plants-flowers and the Plants&Flowers sub-branch of Garden Decor (all faux/artificial plants -- explicit exclusion); /decor/wall-art-decals + child /wall-decals (5 items, all vinyl fabric decals + kids unit-number signage, not framed wall art); /decor/decorative-accents-stationery (8 items: wall calendar, fairy lights, coir door mats, storage box, pencil holders, paper snowflake decor -- majority stationery/holiday/functional, not decor accents); /decor/trays-baskets + children decorative-trays (20, actually foldable storage crates/organiser trays/utensil holders) and decorative-baskets (41, actually Aykasa foldable plastic crates + plain rattan/jute storage baskets) -- site files this whole branch under 'Home Organisation', content confirmed storage-purpose not decorative-display; /decor/bathroom-accessories (89, sampled 24: soap pumps, toothbrush holders, toilet brush, storage bins/caddies, wall shelf racks -- functional bath fixtures/storage, brief excludes these explicitly, only mirrors/lighting carve out); /decor/tissue-boxes was judged the opposite way and INCLUDED (ceramic/wood/travertine sculptural tissue-box covers read as decorative objects, matching the brief's 'decorative wood/ceramic/resin/marble/stone' inclusion, not plain functional boxes); /decor/diffusers-candles (63, Home Fragrance -- explicit exclusion); /kitchen/jugs-carafes (14, sampled: 9 of 14 are Brita water-filter jugs/cartridges -- functional filtration appliance, not decorative jugs); /kitchen/condiment-sets (2 items, both are electric/manual coffee grinders -- mislabeled node, not tableware); /kitchen/table-linen-coasters (68, mixed placemats [textile, exclude] + coasters [decor, include] with no clean URL split -- dropped whole per 'drop don't pad'); /kitchen-tableware-on-display and root /decorative-mirrors-style 'on display' showroom collections (cross-cutting facets, not taxonomy leaves); /kids-plates-tableware (2 plain plastic kids snack bowls, functional, below decor threshold). All furniture, appliances, cookware/cutlery, cleaning, hardware/DIY, storage/organisation, bedding/towels/curtains-fabric, and light bulbs branches were not traversed further (out of scope by brief). Country-appropriate: natively English site, no translation needed.
